1.7
Advantages of the Proposed System
The developed system provides several advantages over traditional search systems:
• Context-aware semantic search.
• Grounded responses instead of hallucinated answers.
• Automatic citation generation.
• Local execution using Ollama, ensuring better privacy.
• Fast vector similarity search using FAISS.
• Secure authentication with JWT.
• Modular and scalable backend architecture.
• Support for multiple document formats.
1.8

• Chapter 2 presents the literature review.
• Chapter 3 discusses requirement analysis.
• Chapter 4 explains the overall system architecture.
• Chapter 5 describes the methodology and workflow.
• Chapter 6 presents implementation details of each module.
• Chapter 7 discusses experimental results and screenshots.
